about: From the user's comments when rejecting batch 1 part_of links (review_log, 2026-11-08/09): endings become 'ended', openings become 'began'.

links.why: Octavian's elevation to Augustus is the conventional end of the Republic and the start of the Empire.
The Ottoman capture of Constantinople ended the Byzantine Empire.
Abolishing the sultanate ended six centuries of Ottoman rule; the Republic of Turkey followed.
Babur's victory over Ibrahim Lodi ended the Delhi Sultanate and opened the Mughal era.
The Soviet Union was formally dissolved, leaving fifteen independent states.
The Xinhai Revolution forced the last emperor's abdication, ending the Qing and imperial China.
Cortés's campaign ended the Aztec Empire with the fall of Tenochtitlan two years later.
Pizarro's capture and execution of Atahualpa ended the Inca Empire as an independent state.
Historians treat the Principia as the culmination and conventional endpoint of the Scientific Revolution.
Florence's early-1400s flowering is the conventional start of the Italian Renaissance.
The storming of the Bastille is the Revolution's symbolic start.
One of the Revolution's founding acts in its first months, setting out its principles.
